description: This file defines a data repository class (FitRepository) for managing workout and step data, along with a placeholder class (SyncManager) for future network synchronization features, in a fitness tracking mobile app.

classes.name: FitRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing workout and step data interactions with the database.

classes.name: SyncManager
classes.description: A placeholder class intended for future implementation of data synchronization with a backend server.

methods.name: addWorkout
methods.description: Inserts a new workout record into the database asynchronously.

methods.name: observeWorkouts
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits the list of all workouts, observing database changes.

methods.name: upsertSteps
methods.description: Inserts or updates the step count for a specific date asynchronously.

methods.name: observeSteps
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits the step data for a specific date.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: A stub suspending function that simulates immediate synchronization, currently always returning true.
